Now in beta: Businesses in ChatGPT.

Claim your business, manage your information, and get insights on how people engage with you.

With Business Hub, verified businesses can update their details and add product feeds with current pricing and availability. They can also see aggregated insights on mentions, website clicks, and common topics in conversations where their business is cited.

Eligible ecommerce and online service businesses in the U.S. can also build a Business Agent to answer customers’ questions and help them explore what they offer. Customers can ask questions, compare products, and find what fits their needs using information provided by the business—all in a clearly labeled conversation, separate from ChatGPT’s independent answers.

We don’t share people’s conversations or Business Agent chats with businesses.

Eligible businesses located wherever ChatGPT is available can get started by claiming their business in Business Hub.
